newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shum Yip's Hong Kong IPO seen over 300X subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Shum Yip's Hong Kong IPO seen over 300X subscribed.

text.p: The initial public offering (IPO) of shares of Shum Yip Investment Ltd in Hong Kong is seen more than 300 times subscribed, market sources said at the close of its IPO on Wednesday.

Shum Yip, which is backed by the municipal government of the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen, offered 250 million shares at HK$1.85 per share in its flotation, 75 million shares of them for the public in Hong Kong.
"The grey market price of the share was at about HK$2.90," a source close to the underwriters said.
The company is expected to make an official statement on the IPO results on March 4. Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on March 7.
Money market sources said the heavy oversubscription in Shum Yip tightened liquidity in the money market and boosted the short-term Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.

"Apart from month-end rollover demand, strong IPO response to Shum Yip boosted the overnight rate to about six percent in late trade (on Wednesday), compared with Tuesday of about 5-1/4 percent," said a money dealer at a European bank.
